text: Ko onon yo yimɓe, adondiree e golle moƴƴe ɗe dañirton yaafaneede junuubi ka Joomi mon: immorde e tuubugol maa kala golle ɓaɗtorɗe Allah ekw, e no heɓiron Allah mo yaajeendi mun wa'i wa yaajeendi kammu ngun e leydi ndin, on maranaama ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ngal keɓal ko ɓural Allah ngal O okkata mo O muuyani e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Allah ko Jom ɓural mawnungal e dow jeyaaɓe Makko gomɗimɓe ɓen.
